text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"automated_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_screen_batch14","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify plate state before run"},{"server":"synthesis","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"thickness":250},"comment":"standard NiFeCoSn film, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":1173,"duration":7200,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"temperature units: K (approx 900 C equivalent), within standard anneal window","label":"std_anneal_profile_A"},{"server":"orchestrator","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"init after anneal"},{"server":"measurement","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2"},{"server":"measurement","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"duration":3600},"comment":"short stability check"},{"server":"analysis","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{},"comment":"update GP surrogate with new point"}]}
